name: bharatlas
description: Plugins from UrbanMorph for bharatlas, India's open geo atlas: query layers, locate points, and author your own collect maps from your LLM.

plugins.name: bharatlas
plugins.description: India's open geo data plus map authoring via MCP. Query curated layers (state to village boundaries, city wards, forests, rivers, hospitals, highways, floods, seismic zones) and community submissions, locate a point across all admin levels and zones, find nearby features, download in 5 formats, and author your own collect maps (register a share link, review contributions, publish to the catalog). No API key for reads.
